result.title: AppCon-Bench: Perception and Misperception of Material Appearance in Vision-Language Models
result.summary: Identifying the same material across changes in illumination or geometry is a critical ability for robust vision systems. Humans exhibit remarkable material appearance constancy, being able to recognize the intrinsic physical properties of an object's surface material across variations in extrinsic, confounding factors such as the lighting or the shape of such object. Vision-Language Models (VLMs) demonstrate strong performance across a wide range of semantic vision tasks, yet their ability to interpret subtle mid-level perceptual attributes remains less understood. We introduce AppCon-Bench, a benchmark comprising five tasks designed to assess material appearance constancy under controlled variations in geometry and illumination, and evaluate representative VLMs alongside human observers, investigating their ability to maintain consistent material judgments across viewing conditions and experimental contexts. After thorough analysis, we identify several key findings that reveal both similarities and systematic differences between human and VLM material appearance perception, highlighting the value of evaluating perceptual successes and failures beyond overall accuracy and informing areas of improvement for current VLMs.

AI.brief_summary: 该论文提出 AppCon-Bench，包含五个任务，在受控的几何与光照变化下考察 VLM 能否对材质外观作出前后一致的判断，并与人类被试对比，分析系统性差异与共性。
AI.relevance_reason: 属于 VLM 感知诊断类基准，直接涉及「视觉细节与中层次属性是否被保留」这一表示问题，可供核查多视角、多光照下视觉证据不变性的失败模式；但其不含 latent 状态生成或推理期机制，与 LVR 的联系限于表示诊断层面。
